fluff.overview: The Marian military tradition places infantry at the foundation of its legionary system, with conventional soldiers organized into units bearing Latin designations that reflect the Hegemony's deliberate cultivation of Roman imperial identity. A centuria, or century, is the Marian equivalent of a company-sized formation. Mechanized tracked centuries ride armored personnel carriers that trade speed for all-terrain capability, providing reliable transport across the rough ground common to many Hegemony garrison worlds. Armed with standard ballistic assault rifles, the most common and affordable infantry weapon available, these formations deliver reliable short-range firepower and can be equipped and resupplied from almost any garrison stockpile.
